summary: Ares Core Infrastructure Fund filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 32,273,724 common shares for $799.5 million in its August 2026 monthly closing, issued at the July 31, 2026 NAV of $24.7711 per share across four classes. The exempt offering under Rule 506(b) and Regulation S is a routine periodic capital raise for a closed-end interval fund. The filing also declared distributions through December 2026. No special-situation event exists; this is standard operational disclosure for the issuer's continuous offering program.
